title: Horion v1.0 - Google Sites (Jan 16, 2026, 6:53pm)
description: The first Horion to go live, published the same evening the old Google Sites homepage got its last update. At 6:53 only the homepage worked - every navbar link was broken - so this first publish is a boot screen and not much else. The changelog starts at 1.0: finished UI, featured games, 1938 database entries. Saved copy of the Google Sites page, since that era left no git history.
